source.title: Dionel - Venus of Dawn
source.name: Dionel
source.description: An outstanding Marksman who makes a big difference under allied reinforcement and continuously deals massive AoE damage.

skills.name: Dawn Light

description.raw: Dionel soars into the air and becomes untargetable for 6s, during which he attacks the area with the most enemies using spear thrust, dealing 170% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to all adjacent enemies. The last hit of spear thrust knocks the enemy into the air, and its damage dealt is increased to 250% (ATK-based).
active: Dionel soars into the air and becomes untargetable for 6s, during which he attacks the area with the most enemies using spear thrust, dealing 170% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to all adjacent enemies.
The last hit of spear thrust knocks the enemy into the air, and its damage dealt is increased to 250% (ATK-based).

text: Unlocks at level 51: Gains a Nectar Feast buff within the effect duration.
Using this skill won't shorten its duration until the skill ends if Dionel has already been buffed.
Unlocks at level 111: Increases the damage of to 180% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) and the damage of its last hit to 260% (ATK-based).
Unlocks at level 171: The skill duration is extended by 2s if Dionel achieves an Assist or Defeat on an enemy hero, triggered only once per casting.
Unlocks at level 231: Increases the damage of to 190% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) and the damage of its last hit to 270% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: Dionel soars into the air and unleashes a wave of . The last hit deals extra damage and knocks the enemy into the air.

skills.name: Starry Void

description.raw: Passive. Dionel's normal attack turns into a Penetration attack, dealing 145% + 15% (SP-based) damage to all enemies along the way.
passive: Dionel's normal attack turns into a Penetration attack, dealing 145% + 15% (SP-based) damage to all enemies along the way.

text: Unlocks at level 71: Increases the Penetration attack damage to 150% + 15% (SP-based).
Unlocks at level 131: Flashes to a better attacking position if not in a good spot, triggered once every 6s.
Unlocks at level 191: Increases the Penetration attack damage to 155% + 15% (SP-based).

skills.description_lite: Increases the range of normal attacks and allow them to penetrate targets.

skills.name: Nectar Feast

description.raw: Passive. Dionel gains a stack of Intoxication when receiving the non-permanent stats boost from an ally, increasing 15% ATK and 15 ATK SPD up to 3 stacks, triggered once only by each ally. Active. Dionel drinks the divine nectar to increase 20% + 2% (SP-based) ATK and 20 + 3 (SP-based) ATK SPD for 12s.
passive: Dionel gains a stack of Intoxication when receiving the non-permanent stats boost from an ally, increasing 15% ATK and 15 ATK SPD up to 3 stacks, triggered once only by each ally.
active: Dionel drinks the divine nectar to increase 20% + 2% (SP-based) ATK and 20 + 3 (SP-based) ATK SPD for 12s.

text: Unlocks at level 91: For each Intoxication stack, the ATK bonus is increased to 16%, and the ATK SPD bonus is increased to 16.
Unlocks at level 151: For each Intoxication stack, the ATK bonus is increased to 18%, and the ATK SPD bonus is increased to 18.
Unlocks at level 211: The bonuses from active casting are increased to 25% + 2% (SP-based) ATK and 25 + 3 (SP-based) ATK SPD.

skills.description_lite: Dionel gains extra buff when boosted by allied heroes and increase ATK and ATK SPD when actively used.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Dionel's normal attack permanently increases his ATK SPD by 3 during battle, for a maximum ATK SPD bonus of 30.
active: Dionel's normal attack permanently increases his ATK SPD by 3 during battle, for a maximum ATK SPD bonus of 30.

text: Dionel's normal attack permanently increases his ATK SPD by 4 during battle, for a maximum ATK SPD bonus of 40.
Dionel's normal attack permanently increases his ATK SPD by 5 during battle, for a maximum ATK SPD bonus of 50.

skills.description_lite: Dionel's normal attack permanently increases his ATK SPD during battle.

skills.name: Celestial Spear

description.raw: Dionel summons a light spear after a short delay, dealing 200% (ATK-based) true damage to all enemies, up to 3 casting per battle. The skill is only available when the owned Intoxication is fully stacked.
active: Dionel summons a light spear after a short delay, dealing 200% (ATK-based) true damage to all enemies, up to 3 casting per battle.
The skill is only available when the owned Intoxication is fully stacked.

text: Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 5: Increases the skill damage dealt to 210% (ATK-based).
Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 10: Deals extra true damage equal to 20% of the target's current HP when first casting the skill in a battle.
Reduces target's Vitality by 60 in the next 8s.
The extra damage is no more than 1000% of ATK.
Unlocks at Exclusive Weapon level 15: Increases the skill damage dealt to 220% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: Dionel deals true damage to all enemies. Only available when the owned intoxication is fully stacked.

skills.name: Enhance Force
